description: Significant decisions with lasting consequence, and why they were made. A decision belongs here when reversing it would cost real work or when a future agent might otherwise re-open it.

decisions.decision: Keep the client's already-deployed 18-table schema and align documents and code to it, rather than tearing down and rebuilding from the phase-3 draft.
alternatives_considered: Teardown and rebuild to match the draft schema
Maintain both and map between them
decisions.rationale: The as-built schema was more correct than the draft — deeper normalisation, better parent lookup naming, JSON-consolidated layout. Rebuilding would have destroyed client work to reach a worse model.
decisions.consequences: Deliverables: schema-reconciliation.md, schema-manifest.json, an as-built banner on phase-3-schema.md. Code is written against the manifest names. Four genuine gap fields were added additively.

decisions.decision: Build the report engine; adopt only narrow point libraries.
alternatives_considered: Adopt an existing reporting framework wholesale
Build everything including PDF, Excel and chart rendering
decisions.rationale: No framework covered metadata-driven CRM-native reporting with the required export set, but PDF, Excel, Word, charting and formula evaluation are solved problems with well-licensed libraries.
decisions.consequences: Adopted NCalc, QuestPDF, Open XML SDK, ClosedXML, ScottPlot, react-querybuilder. Rejected EPPlus v5+ (Polyform), iText7 (AGPL), Jint and DynamicExpresso (code execution). Recorded in dependencies.md.

decisions.decision: Target .NET Framework 4.7.1 for plugin assemblies and persist the target in the csproj via NuGet reference assemblies.
alternatives_considered: Target 4.8 and downgrade only when rejected
Pass msbuild flags at build time
decisions.rationale: Dataverse rejects both 4.8 and 4.7.2 with 0x8004420b, and the build machine has no 4.7.1 targeting pack. Persisting FrameworkPathOverride in the csproj makes plain `dotnet build` reproducible for anyone.
decisions.consequences: One merged, signed artifact is valid for both cloud and on-prem D365 9.x registration.

decisions.decision: Adopt in-repo agent memory, a verification-before-completion protocol, work-type-specific workflows, and dedicated security and UX agents. Defer component extraction, traceability ID enforcement and executable quality gates to a separate engagement.
alternatives_considered: Adopt all seven improvements at once
Adopt none and keep the current prompt-only governance
decisions.rationale: The four adopted items add only new files and prompt directives, so they cannot break a build or a deployment. The three deferred items touch deployed code, intercept every commit, or would fail on projects that have no test script — they need their own scoped engagement.
decisions.consequences: Implemented on branch chore/agent-infrastructure. Deferred items tracked as INFRA-3 (component reuse), INFRA-4 (traceability), INFRA-6 (executable gates).
